_doc: Verbs for the place-order rule (我吃饭在家 -> 我在家吃饭). actions: action verbs that must come AFTER 在 + place. zaiComplement: verbs that may be followed directly by 在 + place (住在河内, 放在桌子上); with an object in between the fix uses 把 (放书在桌子上 -> 把书放在桌子上). notActions: words that begin like an action verb but are not one here (学生, 看见...). Verbs taking a verb phrase (喜欢, 想, 要...) and motion verbs (去, 来, 回, 到) are deliberately absent. STARTER LIST: must be reviewed by a Chinese teacher.
